Parse devcontainer.json and print iso's translation report

Usage: iso devcontainer check [OPTIONS] <PATH>

Arguments:
  <PATH>
          Path to the devcontainer.json file to inspect

Options:
      --stage <STAGE>
          Which lifecycle translation to report

          Possible values:
          - setup: Report setup-time keys such as features, hostRequirements, and remoteUser
          - start: Report start-time keys such as postStartCommand, containerEnv, ports, and mounts
          - both:  Report both setup and start translations
          
          [default: both]

      --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout instead of the text report on stderr

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
